name: gm-tool
description: Mono repo of the GM-Tool project
author: Simon Schötz

scripts.build-local: cd app && pnpm run tauri build -- --debug

simple-git-hooks.pre-commit: staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only --no-renames); printf '%s\n' "$staged" | grep -q '^app/' || exit 0; (cd app && npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint . && npx prettier --check .) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$staged" | grep -q '^app/src-tauri/' || exit 0; cd app/src-tauri && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check
simple-git-hooks.pre-merge-commit: staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only --no-renames); printf '%s\n' "$staged" | grep -q '^app/' || exit 0; (cd app && npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint . && npx prettier --check .) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$staged" | grep -q '^app/src-tauri/' || exit 0; cd app/src-tauri && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check
simple-git-hooks.pre-push: cd app && npx vitest run && cd src-tauri && cargo test
